How a check runs

The model writes. Code decides.

Starts from a pasted transcript, or a recording that Muse Voice Transcribe turns into speaker-labelled turns for the organizer to review.

1Find

Decisions, and the details that could be read two ways. Every quote is checked against the transcript.

Muse SparkCode

2Ask privately

Short multiple-choice questions. Each person answers on their own link, sealed until the reveal.

Muse SparkPeople

3Compare

Answers compared option by option. Where everyone chose the same, it goes straight to the record.

Code

4Settle

Where answers differ, someone proposes wording and everyone confirms it, or they agree to disagree.

People

5Recheck

A new question about what the wording means in practice shows whether it really settled the difference.

Muse SparkCode

6Record

Stated in the meeting, confirmed by participants, or unresolved. Each item links to its quote.

Code

Evaluation only: Muse Spark compared side by side with Muse Spark Open on Baseten. The app itself runs on Muse Spark.
